Hi — I'm Quang. My professional home base is **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / Navision (on-premise)**, with 10 years of experience spanning the full project lifecycle: implementer, developer, and now technical lead, consultant, technical support, and PM assistant.

Alongside that, I hold a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering from Saigon University (SGU) and am currently pursuing a **Master's degree in Software Engineering oriented toward AI applications**. AI is where my curiosity lives outside of work: I spend much of my free time studying and researching it.

This site has two parts: a personal introduction (CV, experience) and a **learning space** collecting what I learn, both course by course in my Master's program and through my own self-study.

### Areas of interest & expertise

- **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central / Navision (on-premise)** — 10 years across the full project lifecycle, from implementation and development to technical leadership, consulting, technical support, and PM assistance
- **AI/ML** — self-directed research and learning, from foundations to applied projects, now structured around a Master's program in AI-oriented software engineering, with a growing focus on computer vision (both classical CV and deep learning)
